# statusdrift_tag (Data Source)

Fetches a single tag by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the tag.
- `name` (String) The name of the tag.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) The color of the tag (hex code).
